INV_DESC_ART_FLASHDRAW: The signature Nail Art of Nailmaster Oro, modified to fit your needs. Instead of dashing, you strike while at rest.

INV_DESC_SPELL_SILKBURST1:
Hornet's prized technique claimed as your own. Release threads of Silk to lash out at your opponents. The threads act as a cushion, weakening blows dealt to the caster. 

The Silk require SOUL to be conjured. Strike enemies to gather SOUL.
